observations: Black pedestal/standing fan with round wire blade guard and five curved blades.
Control panel with buttons and small display built into the fan neck.
Round weighted base on tiled floor, power cord visible trailing to the right in photo 1.
A logo is visible on the center hub in both photos but is obscured by a watermark reading 'STORE' and cannot be read clearly.
No remote control is visible in either photo.
Photos appear to be taken in a plain room with bare wall and exposed electrical socket box in the ceiling.

claims.claim: This is a Qasa rechargeable fan
claims.evidence: Logo on hub in photo 0 and photo 1 is obscured by watermark text and not legible.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged, longer on low
claims.evidence: No video or runtime demonstration provided; battery health cannot be judged from still photos.
No photo or clip shows the fan powered on or spinning.

risks.risk: Battery may be degraded or dead, not meeting claimed 2-hour runtime
risks.proof: A short video of the fan running unplugged on battery with a visible timer or clock
risks.if_unproven: priced as not holding charge / rechargeable function not working

risks.risk: Fan motor or oscillation mechanism may be faulty
risks.proof: A video clip of the fan powered on, oscillating, and blades spinning at multiple speeds

risks.risk: Remote control (if originally included) may be missing
risks.proof: A photo of the remote alongside the fan

risks.risk: Charging adapter/cord may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: A clear photo of the charging adapter and cord separate from the fan

risks.risk: Physical cracks or damage to blades, guard, or base hidden by angle/watermark
risks.proof: Close-up photos of blade tips, guard joints, and base from multiple angles without watermark obstruction
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic condition unknown, assume moderate wear

proof_requests: Video of the fan running on battery (unplugged) showing oscillation and speed changes, with a clock visible to estimate runtime
Clear unobstructed photo of the brand/model logo on the hub
Photo of the remote control and charging adapter/cord if included
Close-up photos of blade edges and guard for cracks or damage
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used rechargeable standing fan, but the brand cannot be confirmed due to the obscured logo and no functional proof (runtime, spinning, charging) is shown, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified-condition rechargeable fan pending the requested proof.
